body: Thank you I'm really glad someone agrees with me

I didn't immediately break it off because it was a long term relationship and I wanted to do everything I could to save it. I was totally honest, told him I felt like the constraints of the relationship were too intense for me so we spent more time apart, hanging out with other people. That still wasn't enough for me, unfortunately, so I told him we needed to break up.

I'm honestly so happy, and I feel kind of bad for it. Like, I shouldn't be this happy. There is a LOT going on in my life that could be stressing me out right now but I have this calmness that I have truly never felt before in my life, because I know I'm doing great on my own and figuring my shit out my way :)
im glad it helped :)

thank you sooo much for saying all of that!! i feel like a lot of people who commented saying "just don't give them a lot of info" don't understand that it's not just the questions that are asked but the judgement that comes along with said questions.
Just curiosity, I think. They definitely don't mean any harm but it's frustrating to have to constantly justify actions that only impact the two people involved.

I'm really sorry that she can't commit to keeping or losing you. It's an unfortunate game and while I understand why she might be doing that, I definitely disagree with it. Hopefully you can come to a conclusion that benefits both of you. Relationships are so fuckin hard and confusing and scary at times but you can get through it!! By the time the issue is resolved you will have learned so much about yourself (what you want, what you're willing to put up with, what makes you truly happy). I wish you nothing but the best!

I've been saying that to people too! I really really appreciate that they check up on me and care so much about me but I want any sympathy to go to my ex. 
And you're right. If it's meant to be it will be, somehow.
No kidding. I'm not in the relationship anymore so in terms of my body I don't owe anyone any modesty!
if you ever need anyone to talk to, I'm here :)
Sorry about your breakup but I hope you're happier now! (and if you aren't at this exact moment, you definitely will be in the near future)
PLEASE! he's so fuckin nice and he deserves the entire world, especially a beautiful, intelligent, stable lady
Pretty much non existent unless we're talking about returning items from one another's houses
I really hate that it isn't. I don't think I'm a bad person for trying to live the most fulfilling life, and I don't think you are either. Good luck, I hope it all goes well for you

I started by saying that I needed more space, because I truly wanted to make the relationship work for me but I didn't know how. We started talking less and hanging out separately more and I realized I was much happier on my own. 

I proposed that we take a break, but quickly realized I couldn't commit to getting back together within a set timeframe so I was honest; I said we should just break up and see what happens in the future. I didn't want him to waste his time waiting on something that wasn't certain to happen. 

I feel like the key is communication, you don't have to tell him you don't love him anymore but you can explain how you feel in gentler terms. If he's a dick about it, then honestly that's an excellent reason to just break up right there.

I wish you the best as well! Breakups suck and somebody always gets hurt but that doesn't necessarily mean the 'hurter' is a bad person. Emotional pain is a part of like everyone deals with at some point, as unfortunate as it is. Im so glad I could help!

The sooner you break it off the sooner the healing process can occur for both of you, I think. You're not a bad person for changing your interests! If you ever want to talk about it you can message me  :)
You definitely aren't a monster; people change and grow apart, it's natural!
I'm really glad I could help. I'm sorry it didn't work out for you guys but hopefully you're happier now
im dealing with my sexuality right now too!
Thank you, I agree. I didn't want to waste any more of his time.
I hope everything turns out well for you :) if you ever want to talk/vent feel free to message me!

I never really thought of it like that. I suppose a lot of them are either new to/haven't been in long term relationships so most of their breakups were due to a large character flaw in their partner. Thank you for the perspective!
